description:
Follow-up to dataframe-csv-empty-string-null-uniform (PR #904, DONE). The fix
made empty-string-vs-null CSV loading uniform, but the regression test covers
only DataFusion and PySpark. The success metric claims uniformity across ALL CSV
adapters; pandas/polars/dask/modin/cudf empty-string -> "" (not null) parity is
asserted nowhere new — it rests on untouched legacy behavior with no pin. #904
also landed the coercion per-adapter rather than as the single shared step the
YAML specified (functionally equivalent, but it means each adapter is its own
risk surface). This item pins the contract for the remaining adapters and adds a
CSV-path cross-surface case.

Test-only by intent: if a parity gap surfaces for any adapter, STOP and file a
defect TODO — do not fix adapter behavior inside this coverage item.

anti_patterns.dont: fix an adapter parity gap inside this test-only item
anti_patterns.why: surface it as a defect TODO.

anti_patterns.dont: introduce a new benchmark or heavyweight fixture for the cross-surface case; reuse a small existing one.

deferrals.reason: Functionally equivalent today; consolidation is a separate maintainability item, not coverage.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] duplicate: Exact match: open item dataframe-csv-coercion-single-shared-step already tracks this consolidation.
deferrals.summary: Refactor the per-adapter coercion into the single shared step #904's YAML originally specified.

preserves.behavior: Fast lane stays green on a standard dev environment (availability skips for absent adapters).
No change to adapter CSV-loading behavior — this is coverage only.

prior_art.concept: {'ref': 'tests/integration/test_dataframe_csv_empty_string_null_semantics.py', 'note': 'The #904 regression test covering DataFusion+PySpark; parametrize its existing assertions across the remaining adapters rather than authoring a new harness.'}

verifications.description: Empty-string/null parity holds across installed adapters
verifications.expected: per-adapter parametrized cells pass for pandas/polars/dask/modin; cudf skipped if absent

work_units.summary: Re-confirm on fresh develop that the #904 test still covers only DataFusion+PySpark

work_units.notes:
Extend the existing test to assert, per adapter, the null-marker-dependent
contract: a bare empty field loads as "" when csv_null_marker is None, and
as null when csv_null_marker == "". This is not a single uniform outcome —
"uniform" means the same null-marker-conditioned rule holds identically
across adapters, not that a bare empty field always loads as null. Guard
cudf and any non-installed adapter with availability skips so the fast lane
stays green on a standard dev env.
work_units.summary: Parametrize empty-string/null CSV semantics across pandas, polars, dask, modin (cudf availability-skipped)

work_units.notes:
Add at least one cross-surface equivalence case that forces the CSV load path
(prefer_parquet=False) so SQL<->DataFrame empty-string/null parity is exercised
end-to-end, not only per-adapter loading. Reuse an existing small cross-surface
fixture rather than a new benchmark.
work_units.summary: Add a cross-surface CSV-path case (prefer_parquet=False) exercising SQL<->DataFrame parity
